ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio characterized by a dominant high-intensity white background (approximately 85%) and localized low-intensity dark-grey/black pigmentation (approximately 15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white primary surface area with multiple discrete, low-intensity dark focal spots (mottling) clustered heavily toward the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central notch with an approximate interior pixel angle of 65 degrees and a moderate depth-to-aperture ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations and irregular peaks/valleys extracted along the entire continuous trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical curve shows a distinct convexity sweeping upwards and outwards from the median notch to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive distribution of roughly circular, high-contrast dark pixel clusters (3-15 pixels in diameter) across the white ventral field, most concentrated on the medial and distal regions of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of high-intensity, textured pixel masses (attached barnacles) at the extreme lateral tips of both fluke lobes and intermittently along the leading edge.
